osiLayers.name: Application Layer
osiLayers.functions: Provides network services directly to end-user software applications (Web browsers, Email clients). Human-computer interaction layer.

osiLayers.name: Presentation Layer
osiLayers.functions: Syntax and semantics translation, Data Representation, Encryption & Decryption (SSL/TLS), Compression & Decompression.
osiLayers.standards: ASCII, EBCDIC, Unicode, JPEG, MPEG, GIF, SSL/TLS, MIME
osiLayers.examHighlight: Responsible for Data Encryption and Compression. Very frequent question!

osiLayers.name: Session Layer
osiLayers.functions: Establishes, manages, synchronizes, and terminates communication sessions between applications. Inserts synchronization checkpoints.

osiLayers.name: Transport Layer
osiLayers.functions: End-to-end delivery of the entire message, process-to-process communication via Port Addressing, Flow Control (sliding window), Error Control, Congestion Control.

coreProtocols.name: TCP (Transmission Control Protocol)
coreProtocols.type: Connection-oriented, reliable, 3-way handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK), acknowledges receipt, retransmits lost packets.

coreProtocols.name: UDP (User Datagram Protocol)
coreProtocols.type: Connectionless, unreliable, lightweight, fast, no acknowledgements, no retransmission.
coreProtocols.usedFor: VoIP, live streaming, DNS queries, online gaming

osiLayers.examHighlight: Heart of OSI Model. Port addressing happens at Transport Layer.

osiLayers.name: Network Layer
osiLayers.functions: Source-to-destination packet delivery across multiple network links (Host-to-Host). Logical Addressing (IP addresses), Routing path determination (Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford).

osiLayers.name: Data Link Layer (DLL)

sublayers.name: LLC (Logical Link Control)
sublayers.desc: Flow control, error control, multiplexes network layer protocols.

sublayers.name: MAC (Media Access Control)
sublayers.desc: Hardware addressing (48-bit MAC address), regulates medium access (CSMA/CD, CSMA/CA).

osiLayers.functions: Hop-to-hop (node-to-node) delivery, physical addressing (MAC), framing, error detection (CRC - Cyclic Redundancy Check), flow control.

osiLayers.name: Physical Layer
osiLayers.functions: Transmission of raw unstructured bitstream over physical transmission medium. Defines electrical voltages, pin configurations, cable types, signal bit duration.

mnemonics.topDown: All People Seem To Need Data Processing (Application -> Physical)
mnemonics.bottomUp: Please Do Not Throw Sausage Pizza Away (Physical -> Application)

specialAddresses.purpose: Loopback address (localhost testing of TCP/IP stack)
Automatic Private IP Addressing (assigned when DHCP server is unreachable)

ipv6.notation: 8 groups of 4 hexadecimal digits separated by colons (e.g. 2001:0db8:85a3:0000:0000:8a2e:0370:7334)
ipv6.compression: Leading zeroes in a group can be omitted; consecutive groups of zeroes replaced once by '::'
ipv6.features: Virtually inexhaustible address space (3.4 * 10^38 addresses), built-in IPsec, no broadcast (uses multicast and anycast), auto-configuration (SLAAC).

macAddress.structure: First 24 bits = OUI (Organizationally Unique Identifier assigned by IEEE to hardware manufacturer); Last 24 bits = Device identifier assigned by vendor.

masterPortList.desc: Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (sending email between servers)
Domain Name System (resolves domain name to IP address; UDP for queries <512B)
Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol server listener
Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol client port (DORA process)
Trivial File Transfer Protocol (lightweight file transfer for bootstrapping)
Post Office Protocol version 3 (downloads emails to client and deletes from server)
Internet Message Access Protocol (syncs emails across multiple devices)
HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure (HTTP over SSL/TLS)
Remote Desktop Protocol (Microsoft Windows Remote Desktop)
